free_tier.stated: no free tier: a dedicated Mac mini M4 is sold at USD 15/day, USD 89/week or USD 159/month, and access is granted after successful payment; all three plan cards showed sold out on 2026-11-25

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a whole dedicated machine, not an object

retention.stated: the machine is wiped when a rental ends or is cancelled and data is not recoverable afterwards; a 24-hour daily rental that is not renewed ends with the machine and all its data permanently deleted

egress.terms: a 1Gb/s internet connection and a static IP are included; no transfer allowance or egress price is published

interface_detail: a remote desktop connection or SSH to a dedicated bare-metal Mac mini M4 with full-admin access and a static IP; no API is documented
tooling: a remote desktop client or an SSH client; the machine can be registered as a self-hosted GitHub Actions, GitLab or Buildkite runner
chaining: a whole dedicated Mac with full admin can serve as a permanent macOS build box for Xcode, signing and notarization, or as a self-hosted CI runner; it composes with any CI that accepts a self-hosted runner, but no free allowance exists and no machine was in stock on 2026-11-25, so it cannot be started without a paid order and available stock.

limits.value: a minimum rental of 24 hours under Apple's macOS Software License Agreement; no shorter rental is available and cancelling inside the first 24 hours does not shorten or refund that period

limits_note: no monthly compute hours are included: every plan is a paid rental that renews until cancelled; all shown plan cards were sold out on 2026-11-25.
binding_note: the 24-hour minimum and the absence of any included free hours bind first: the cheapest entry is a non-refundable 24-hour paid rental, and no machine was in stock on 2026-11-25.

identity_cost.detail: access is granted after successful payment, prices are processed via Stripe, and the login asks for the email used at checkout to receive a secure link; the terms say the operator may require verification of identity or intended use at any time

reliability_note: no uptime guarantee; the machines are hosted by third-party infrastructure providers, and all plans showed sold out on 2026-11-25, so delivery depends on stock.
confidence_note: prices, hardware, access method and egress speed are quoted from the vendor's own rent-a-mac and mac-mini-cloud pages read on 2026-11-25; the 24-hour minimum, Stripe payment, wipe-on-end and identity-verification clause are quoted from the vendor's terms; the login email gate is quoted from the vendor's login page.
